Tests separately prove named focusable regions, ArrowRight movement and viewport reachability of initially visible enabled actions.

The 320px light workflow screenshot preserves the import month heading, search input, loaded-page count and table surface. The recorded timestamp extends into the horizontally scrollable comparison table; the image alone does not prove access to every cell. Normal geometry assertions cover document and search width, not all table cell visibility.

The 320px historical preview shows shared four-step progress, distinct historical month/explanation, correction-oriented review, rejection CSV action and Apply hierarchy. The native picker says No file selected while the retained filename is separately shown; this inherited ambiguity remains follow-up work and is not silently certified.

The 844px dark computed-text200 step strip remains readable with all four stages in sequence and current Review emphasis. R5 progress geometry covers the progress root and dots rather than full-page text or every label rectangle.
